suites.name: UC-01A: Rural Citizen / Consumer Buyer Signup & Phone OTP Login
suites.description: Full buyer onboarding: stages user profile for usr_8977848501, opens login dialog, verifies 6-digit OTP, checks default buyer role and village badge, and signs out.

suites.name: UC-01B: Kirana Merchant Registration & Fullscreen Corridor Ingress
suites.description: Full merchant onboarding: registers merchant business profile, authenticates via OTP, elevates role to merchant, verifies fullscreen corridor at /m/gigs, and signs out.

suites.name: UC-01C: Fleet Transporter / Driver Signup & Mobile PWA Ingress
suites.description: Full transporter onboarding: registers driver vehicle credentials, authenticates driver session, validates mobile PWA layout and route manifests, and signs out.

suites.name: UC-01D: Regional Mill Supplier Registration & Depot Portal Ingress
suites.description: Full supplier onboarding: registers agricultural mill entity, authenticates supplier admin, audits escrow funds balance sheet, and signs out.

suites.name: UC-01E: Support Specialist Console & RBAC Privilege Elevation
suites.description: Full operator security: authenticates tier-2 support specialist, accesses operations ticket console at /x, validates RBAC privilege elevation, and signs out.

suites.name: UC-01F: Finance & Tax Officer Audit Sign-In & Ledger Security
suites.description: Full audit ingress: authenticates certified finance & tax officer, audits GST withholding schedules and platform balance sheet, and signs out.

suites.name: UC-01G: Platform SRE Zero-Trust Sign-In & Mesh Observability
suites.description: Full observability ingress: authenticates platform site reliability engineer, verifies zero-trust token, inspects microservices health mesh, and signs out.

suites.name: UC-01H: Progressive Role Elevation with Operations Verification
suites.description: Full role transition: starts as rural buyer, submits merchant upgrade request, simulates ops team approval, validates role elevation token, and signs out.

suites.name: UC-01I: Multilingual Regional Dialect Selection (6 Languages)
suites.description: Full localization journey: toggles Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, English, verifies RTL/LTR layout and i18n persistence across sessions.

suites.name: UC-01J: Federated Google OAuth Alternative Sign-In Simulation
suites.description: Full federated SSO: initiates Google OAuth 2.0 flow, validates JWT assertion exchange, maps verified email to enterprise profile, and signs out.

suites.name: UC-01K: Inactive / Suspended Account Lockout Circuit Breaker
suites.description: Full security circuit breaker: flags compromised account with SUSPENDED status, tests authentication rejection (403), verifies lockout banner, and resets.

suites.name: UC-04: Trade Credit 2-Phase Hold & Headroom Circuit Breaker
suites.description: 2-Phase credit reservation: stages ₹50k limit, reserves valid ₹2,500 hold, rejects over-headroom hold with HTTP 402, and commits authorization.

suites.name: UC-05: Bulk Pamphlet Consignment Order & UPI QR Generation
suites.description: Full commerce checkout: constructs multi-item village pamphlet cart, calculates taxes, issues dynamic UPI QR payment intent, and reconciles settlement.

suites.name: UC-06: Hub Departure Gate Clearance & Cryptographic Handover OTP Verification
suites.description: Full chain-of-custody dispatch: records hub vehicle departure gate checklist, verifies dual-party 4-digit handover OTP, and updates consignment state.

suites.name: UC-07: Damaged Goods Rejection & 72-Hour RTO Protocol
suites.description: Full reverse logistics: rejects damaged goods at doorstep, flags return reason code, schedules 72-hr RTO vehicle return window, and releases buyer hold.

suites.name: UC-08: CoD Cash Collection, Custody Tracking & Daily Limit Guard
suites.description: CoD cash custody: checks initial zero balance, records customer cash collection, increments active custody, and triggers ₹50,000 transit ceiling guard (422).

suites.name: UC-09: End-of-Shift Cash Turn-In & Cryptographic Handover OTP Verification
suites.description: Depot turn-in: stages physical cash handover, verifies 6-digit cryptographic turn-in OTP, discharges driver custody balance to ₹0, and updates depot cash safe.

suites.name: UC-10: Cash Discrepancy & The Payout Custody Gate Circuit Breaker
suites.description: Discrepancy circuit breaker: flags ₹200 shortfall during turn-in, trips payout custody gate, blocks instant withdrawal (422), and routes ticket to audit queue.

suites.name: UC-11: Bank Beneficiary Registration & KMS Account Encryption
suites.description: Encrypted beneficiary setup: registers bank account & IFSC code, encrypts sensitive account numbers with Cloud KMS envelope encryption, and confirms active state.

suites.name: UC-12: Cloud Tasks IMPS Bank Transfer Execution & UTR Settlement
suites.description: Automated payout: enqueues payout job via Cloud Tasks, executes simulated IMPS transfer via bank gateway, and records 12-digit UTR confirmation code.

suites.name: UC-13: Supplier Funds Tracking, Merchant Commission & Driver Allocation Governance Console
suites.description: Escrow governance: audits supplier funds ledger, tracks 2.5% merchant PUDO commission, allocates driver kilometer remuneration, and balances escrow reserve.

suites.name: UC-14: UPI TPAP Compliance, VPA Syntax Validation & Blacklist Rejection
suites.description: NPCI TPAP enforcement: validates strict VPA handle syntax, tests sanitization against suspicious characters, and enforces instant blacklist rejection (400).

suites.name: UC-15: Real-Time AML Fraud Velocity Interception & Account Freeze Gate
suites.description: Fraud velocity circuit breaker: tracks rapid multi-transaction velocity, detects structuring anomalies, freezes suspect account, and alerts compliance.

suites.name: UC-16: Dispute SLA Tracking, 24-Hour Countdown & Daily NPCI Compliance Report
suites.description: Dispute SLA governance: tracks active UPI chargebacks, renders live 24-hour statutory countdown clock, and compiles daily regulatory compliance export.

suites.name: UC-17: Multi-Role Versioned Clickwrap Policy Consent & Mandatory Re-Consent Gate
suites.description: Versioned consent gate: records cryptographic timestamped clickwrap acceptance, bumps legal terms version (v2.1), and intercepts unconsented requests.

suites.name: UC-18: Double-Entry Platform General Ledger & Zero-Sum Invariance Invariant Gate
suites.description: Double-entry integrity: audits multi-currency ledger entries, verifies debit/credit exact equality, and rejects unbalanced journal batches with invariant violation.
